findings.problem: The skeleton assumes exactly two meta cells (Hit rate, Entry), but the real post-B BetslipCardView renders combined_hit_rate and stake conditionally (!= null), so the loaded card can show 0, 1, or 2 cells. The testability note asserts 'exactly two meta cells' as a regression guard, which actually only needs to guard against a Multiplier/odds cell returning.
findings.fix: Reword the deliverable-C test assertion to 'renders at most two meta cells and no Multiplier/odds cell', or state the skeleton intentionally models the both-fields-present case. Keep the two-cell visual.

findings.problem: Columns (Win %, Wins/Settled, Net record) are the correct odds-free interpretation, but the original request said 'who won how much'. Users may expect a currency figure the board intentionally does not show.
findings.fix: Add in-UI copy or a tooltip clarifying 'Net = wins minus settled losses (not coins)', mirroring the planned category-copy note.

findings.problem: Making createBetslipSchema.odds optional/nullable and dropping it from insert is correct and internally consistent (payout no longer computed, so NaN risk removed). Residual-reference risk is low but should be confirmed.
findings.fix: At the end of step 6 run a repo-wide grep for '\.odds\b' and rely on TypeScript to confirm zero references to the deleted leaf functions, as the design already plans.
